d: A skeletal figure of an indeterminate age and maturity with a slender, bony build. The entity wears tattered, off-white fabric wraps and a draped shawl with blue striped borders, complemented by a thick brown rope necklace featuring a silver anchor pendant. The head is replaced by a large, transparent glass bottle containing a miniature sailing ship on blue water, decorated with small white shells and a single orange starfish. Visible skeletal hands and arms are adorned with blue nautical tattoos. BODY COLOR: beige bone
